text_block_list.text:
~ Gold Ship: The Unsinkable Battleship 
Chapter ~ ―― Epilogue ――
(Crash... wash...)

Under the crimson sky, the sound of the 
waves beats a soothing rhythm...

With a peaceful feeling, I casually glance 
beside me...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Congrats-sea-bream on finishing the 
Twinkle Series!! Now where's the sea 
breeeeam~~?!

—Gold Ship was trying to catch a sea bream 
with furious intensity.
choice_data_list: (How did it end up like this again...?)

text_block_list.text:
Listening to the sound of the waves, I 
decided to sort out my thoughts.

Gold Ship achieved wonderful results in 
the Twinkle Series, triumphantly making it 
through her first three years.

And while I was looking for her to 
celebrate...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: TREASUREEE!! WHERE IS THE TREASUREEE?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Automated Teller Machi— I mean, 
Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Truth is, the adventurer blood sleepin' 
inside me suddenly decided to wake 
up...!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If I don't find the treasure soon, every 
living thing is gonna start lookin' like 
an automated teller machine to me...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right!? That's why I'm thinking of heading 
out right now!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, you're coming too, aren't you?! 
Get ready! We depart in 60 seconds!!

And so, I ended up embarking on a journey 
with Gold Ship, and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Look! That fish is a weird color! It might 
be a new species! Let's catch it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what a uniquely shaped stag beetle! 
If it's a rare species, it'll fetch a high 
price! Careful now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's a huge hermit crab! That's 
gotta be a mutant! Don't let it get away!

And so, I lost track of how much time had 
passed, but—
Before I knew it, I had reached the sea.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"We've come to the sea together quite a 
few times now, haven't we...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In the end, maybe it's just our fate to be 
born from the sea and return to the sea...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I don't even remember why the hell we came 
to the beach in the first place, but...

"Come to think of it—I got so caught up in 
her antics that I forgot the most 
important thing."

There's just one thing... that I have to 
say.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ngh...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's with you all of a sudden? Coming at 
me with an abrupt crash-course in 
gratitude?
choice_data_list: Because you did your best in the race

text_block_list.text:
That the first three years are crucial for 
an Umamusume at Tracen Academy.

I told her how she had concluded that 
period with truly magnificent results. 
Upon hearing this—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, seriously? Then I'm super 
amazing, aren't I?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I meant. Celebrate a 
little more enthusiastically, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: L-i-k-e I said—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now's not the time to be chilling out, 
damn it!! Crank up the celebration hype 
way more, dammit!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Shout it at the top of your lungs for the 
heavens to hear!! Congratulations, I 
say!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Auspicious, felicitous, 
sea-bream-tastic!!!! Wooooah, where is the 
sea breeeeam~~!?

And that is how Gold Ship went off to 
catch sea bream—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright!! Sea bream secured!!

Having safely caught the sea bream, we 
decided to eat it together.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, I'm stuffed. That sea bream was so 
good~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right? Both the plump, fresh sashimi and 
the piping hot grilled fish were so good~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, it might be late to say this, 
but you fit in crazy well, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Back in the beginning, you freaked out 
just from me lightly bagging you up and 
carrying you around.

Perhaps because I've spent so much time 
dealing with Gold Ship, I find myself 
readily accepting the current situation.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good. Not many people can sync up 
with my biorhythms. Be proud of that."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Man, it's really getting late...
(Crash... wash...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if we'll be able to see the sea 
fireflies soon...
(Crash... wash...)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll look for some constellations in 
the night sky...

"The sound of the waves is so soothing to 
my tired body... My eyelids are naturally 
growing heavy..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, Trainer? You alive? Hey, heeey!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yep, totally asleep.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Right, as a sign of affection, maybe I'll 
write 'Gold' on your forehead. Alright..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You might not realize it, but anyone who 
can keep up with me is pretty damn crazy 
in their own right, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I made 'Gold'! ...Ahahaha! I like this!

The next time I woke up, I was back at the 
academy— with Gold Ship grinning right in 
front of my face.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! That's hilaaarious!

I would only learn later... that her smile 
was due to the 'money' on her forehead.
